speechOptions.instruction: Calm, confident, measured — short declarative sentences, like a good product keynote. No exclamation marks in delivery, no salesy energy. Let the pauses between sentences breathe.

title: MulmoTerminal — stop the server from the browser
description: Short feature clip. The terminal that started the server is often the one window you are not looking at; Settings has a Quit button, and `mulmoterminal stop` works from any terminal. Slides are English in both language versions.

beats.text: The terminal that started the server is the one window you are not looking at. Now you can stop it from the browser — or with one command.
